features.name: normalized_climb_rate
features.description: Standardized climb rate using training mean and std, clipped to [-3, 3] for SVM margin stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized continuous feature directly usable by linear SVM without scale distortion

features.name: roll_pitch_interaction
features.description: Product of normalized curRoll and curPitch capturing coupled rotational dynamics
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nonlinear interaction between roll and pitch axes useful as a linear projection for SVM

features.name: angular_rate_magnitude
features.description: Combined magnitude of pitch rate q and roll rate p as a composite rotational severity measure
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous severity measure of rotational activity useful for linear margin separation

features.name: abs_roll_deviation
features.description: Deviation of absRoll from its training mean, normalized by std, indicating unusual roll magnitude
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized deviation feature with smooth distribution suitable for linear SVM hyperplane

features.name: climb_diff_ratio
features.description: Ratio of diffClb to climbRate magnitude capturing relative rate of change in climb, with safe division
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio feature capturing relative dynamics useful as approximate linear projection for SVM

features.name: se_time_spread
features.description: Range of SeTime values across sensors 1-14 capturing variability in sensor timing
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous spread measure of sensor timing useful for detecting anomalous flight states
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(SeTime14, SeTime13), np.maximum(SeTime12, SeTime11)), np.maximum(np.maximum(SeTime10, SeTime9), np.maximum(SeTime8, SeTime7))) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(SeTime1, SeTime2), np.minimum(SeTime3, SeTime4)), np.minimum(np.minimum(SeTime5, SeTime6), SeTime7))

features.name: mean_se_time_normalized
features.description: Average of SeTime1 through SeTime7 normalized by training mean Se, capturing sensor timing level
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized composite of sensor timing features useful for linear SVM
features.formula: ((SeTime1 + SeTime2 + SeTime3 + SeTime4 + SeTime5 + SeTime6 + SeTime7) / 7.0) / 0.022063

features.name: diff_se_time_activity
features.description: Sum of absolute values of odd-indexed diffSeTime features capturing sensor timing change activity
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregate sensor activity measure providing smooth continuous input for linear SVM
features.formula: np.abs(diffSeTime1) + np.abs(diffSeTime3) + np.abs(diffSeTime5) + np.abs(diffSeTime7) + np.abs(diffSeTime9) + np.abs(diffSeTime11) + np.abs(diffSeTime13)

features.name: alpha_pitch_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of alpha and curPitch normalized by their training means capturing angle of attack dynamics
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of aerodynamic angle features useful as a weighted composite for SVM margin

features.name: sgz_normalized
features.description: Normalized vertical acceleration Sgz clipped to [-3, 3] sigma range for SVM stability
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth standardized vertical acceleration feature directly usable by linear SVM

features.name: roll_rate_severity
features.description: Semantic severity score from 0 to 1 assessing how extreme the combined roll-related signals are: high absolute curRoll, large diffRollRate, and extreme absRoll together indicate severe roll conditions. Score near 1 means highly abnormal roll state.
features.expected_model_benefit: Interpretable severity score capturing roll instability useful as a smooth continuous SVM feature

features.name: flight_instability_index
features.description: Composite instability index from 0 to 1 integrating climb rate variability (diffClb, diffDiffClb), angular rates (p, q), and roll deviation into a single smooth severity measure. Near 1 indicates highly unstable flight conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite instability score providing a strong linear projection for SVM decision boundary
